C1506.title: Medtronic Recalls Insulin Pump Remote Controllers Affected by Vulnerabilities
C1506.summary: In October 2021, globally recognized medical device manufacturer Medtronic announced a recall of certain insulin pump remote controllers due to critical security vulnerabilities. Attackers could exploit these flaws to alter the insulin dosage delivered to patients, potentially causing injury or death.
